presets.name: Rover navigation and mobility
presets.mission: Curiosity-type rover driving and route planning
presets.why: Terrain decides mobility; surface material (thermal inertia, albedo) separates dunes, gravel and bedrock.
presets.verdict_reason: Trained at 11 km on 19 known analog areas; hidden known analogs: mean rank 37941 -> 34845 (+8.2%), 12/19 improved
declared_limitations: Pressure: every Earth site has roughly 80-150x Mars' air pressure (P5, not scored).
Sunlight and UV: no comparable data; Mars has no ozone layer (P5, not scored).
Dust: no Earth equivalent of the Martian dust layer (P6, not scored).
Gravity and radiation are not reproduced on Earth.
Resolution: 1-degree cells (about 110 km) are far coarser than rover-scale terrain.

presets.name: Ground-ice prospecting (ISRU)
presets.mission: Drilling and extraction tests for shallow ground ice
presets.why: Ice is a hard requirement for the Earth site. Similarity then favours cold, flat plains.
presets.verdict_reason: Trained at 11 km on 6 known analog areas; hidden known analogs: mean rank 15147 -> 10693 (+29.4%), 5/6 improved
declared_limitations: Pressure: every Earth site has roughly 80-150x Mars' air pressure (P5, not scored).
Sunlight and UV: no comparable data; Mars has no ozone layer (P5, not scored).
Dust: no Earth equivalent of the Martian dust layer (P6, not scored).
Gravity and radiation are not reproduced on Earth.
Resolution: 1-degree cells (about 110 km) are far coarser than rover-scale terrain.

Mars ice flag in this grid needs >= 10 wt% H2O; Arcadia shows about 5 wt% so it is flagged 0 although Science reports ice centimetres below the surface. Ice is used as a requirement on Earth sites instead.
Earth ice data covers northern-hemisphere permafrost only (Antarctic sites show no ice).

future_note: Future years: CMIP6 multi-model mean (WorldClim 2.1). Changed: air temperature incl. the day-night air swing, precipitation and aridity (dry-land filter). NDVI (vegetation: no global projection exists), ground temperature, terrain, rock type, craters and albedo stay as today (no projection). The app interpolates linearly between the projected years.
dry_bare_rule: NDVI < 0.2 (bare ground), not ice or water, and aridity index <= 0.2 (arid + hyper-arid) or a cold desert (mean air temperature < 0 degC, precipitation < 250 mm/yr, albedo < 0.6) (Science)
common_limitations: Pressure: every Earth site has roughly 80-150x Mars' air pressure (P5, not scored).
Sunlight and UV: no comparable data; Mars has no ozone layer (P5, not scored).
Dust: no Earth equivalent of the Martian dust layer (P6, not scored).
Gravity and radiation are not reproduced on Earth.
Resolution: 11 km cells on both planets (Earth 0.1 deg, Mars 0.1875 deg). Rock type, minerals and ground ice still come from 1-degree data; Mars temperatures come from a ~200 km climate model.
Only cells that are Mars-like dry land in some year are included, so 'dry land only' cannot be switched off at 11 km.

compact.note: Earth: only cells that are Mars-like dry land in at least one year (268,375 of 2.13 M land cells).

resolution_note: 11 km grid built from WorldClim 2.1, MODIS (OpenLandMap), MOLA and TES; see the Analog Atlas for the method.
